Stabilize project-scoped env loading and improve the article illustration workflow.

## cover-image 1.0.3

- Internal change: updated `scripts/setup.mjs`.
- No changes to user-facing features or workflow.
- All usage, configuration, and documentation remain the same.

- Added 17 files to support new shared image generation tooling and references.
- Introduced vendor scripts for setup, model registry, preferences, and workflow automation.
- Enhanced documentation with configuration guides and style/method references.
- No breaking changes; this release expands internal generation utilities and reference material.

- Initial release for cover-image skill.
- Generate structured article cover images, blog headers, newsletter heroes, or key visual banners.
- Guided by six core dimensions: type, palette, rendering, text, mood, aspect.
- Includes reference image guidance (public URLs, https preferred).
- Bundled scripts for project scaffolding, multi-variant batch generation, and output compression.
- Secure API usage; outputs organized in `.image-skills/cover-image/` directories.
- Supports style and language customization, with clear iteration paths for user feedback.

cover-image v0.1.2

- Removed 17 files related to shared image generation references and scripts, simplifying the codebase.
- Updated vendor core scripts for client and error handling.
- No user-facing feature changes, but toolchain and maintenance are improved for lighter installs.

- Major vendor refactor: Replaces previous vendor/generation-runtime and vendor/compression-runtime with updated scripts under scripts/vendor/.
- Adds shared-image-generation and weryai-core logic as scriptable modules.
- All image generation, compression, and supporting scripts now accessed via updated vendor paths.
- Updates workflow to use npm run generate for image creation instead of vendor/generation-runtime/scripts/main.ts directly.
- SKILL.md revised with improved environment variable requirements, new script locations, and more accurate workflow instructions.
- Removes legacy vendor directories and legacy references.

Initial release: generate article cover images with structured decision dimensions and bundled tooling.

- Supports generation of cover images, blog headers, newsletter hero images, and banner-style visuals.
- Guides users through a workflow with six structured dimensions: type, palette, rendering, text, mood, and aspect.
- Provides scripts for project scaffolding and batch prompt preparation.
- Handles reference images via public URLs (HTTPS recommended).
- Ensures safety: uses API key securely, writes files to project directory, and avoids arbitrary shell execution.
